Hi, I'm Harshil — currently pursuing the Master of Data Science program at the University of British Columbia. Before that, I was a Data Scientist at **Fractal Analytics** in Bangalore, building GenAI and machine learning systems for clients across safety analytics, healthcare, and customer operations. I studied Computer Science with a specialization in Data Science at Symbiosis Institute of Technology, and my work has moved from behavioural risk modeling to retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent orchestration, and production LLM systems — knowledge I'm now looking to deepen at UBC.

I like turning messy, real-world problems into models and pipelines people can actually rely on — and I'm just as happy debugging a stubborn retrieval pipeline at 11pm as I am sketching out a new project on a whiteboard.

Outside of work, I run and cycle, and cook more ambitiously than I should. Take a look at [what I've built](about.qmd) or read a few [notes from the field](blog.qmd).
